summary: Structural wall sections and notes sheet reviewed. The sheet contains a potentially conflicting pair of soil-pressure values and two title-block/drafting-field deficiencies. Other reviewed structural loads, materials, connection notes, and referenced standards were not reported because the sheet did not show a sufficiently supported discrepancy.

drafts.title: Conflicting soil pressure values appear in structural notes
drafts.observation: The sheet states both an assumed allowable soil bearing capacity of 1,500 PSF and a minimum design soil pressure of 2,500 PSF. These values appear to address the same foundation design condition, but the governing basis or distinction between them is not stated.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Under MASONRY AND FOUNDATION NOTES, item 1 states: "ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL IS 1,500 PSF." Item 8 states: "MINIMUM DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF, TO BOTTOM OF FOOTING DEPTH SHOWN ON DRAWINGS..."
drafts.drawing_location: Structural notes block, MASONRY AND FOUNDATION NOTES, items 1 and 8, right half of sheet.
drafts.recommendation: Have the structural/geotechnical design team reconcile the 1,500 PSF allowable bearing capacity with the 2,500 PSF minimum design soil pressure, identify the governing value and its design basis, and revise the notes or supporting geotechnical documentation as needed. The applicable code/design basis needs professional verification.

drafts.title: Sheet-count field appears incomplete
drafts.observation: The title block includes the label "SHEET:" followed by "OF 00," but no sheet number is printed before the sheet-count notation.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Title block reads: "SHEET: OF 00"; the separate page field identifies the sheet as "S-201.00."
drafts.recommendation: Complete the title-block sheet-count field or confirm that the intended sheet-number and total-sheet information is shown consistently throughout the permit set.

drafts.title: Wall Section 2 scale notation is malformed
drafts.observation: The scale notation for Wall Section 2 is printed without an equals sign, making the intended scale notation ambiguous.
drafts.drawing_evidence: The Wall Section 2 caption reads: "SCALE: 3/4"1'-0"". Wall Section 1 is separately shown as "SCALE: 3/4"=1'-0"."
drafts.recommendation: Correct the Wall Section 2 scale notation to match the intended scale and the notation used for Wall Section 1.
